  • Original-date: 20 Nov 1978 0047-EST
Comments of the form (comment foo, bar, bletch) run afoul of the BACKQ macro
if they appear after a ` in a file being read in.  Comments of this form are
useful for the @ (AT) listing package, and commas occur naturally in this
context.  I'm not sure this should be fixed, but it should be advertised.

Scott Fahlman (FAHLMAN @ CMUA)
